items.note: Puranic tradition: the region once under a branch of the Haihayas known as the Pradyut dynasty, also called Dasharna

Besnagar placed between the Bes (Halali) and Vetrawati (Betwa); tradition connects it with Raja Rukmangad and his son Dharmaraj
Sun Temple at Vidisha built V.S. 935 (A.D. 992) on the Vetrawati, its gates engraved with shlokas of a Kavya by Chittrappa
Belief that Balmiki had an ashram near Madagan and that Lateri was once Jamdagni's ashram teaching Purana, Jyotish, Ayurveda etc.
Vidisha in the works of Kalidasa, Bhasa and Dandi; Agnimitra Sunga ruler of Vidisha; Pushyamitra performed Ashvamedha at Vidisha

Under Akbar Vidisha part of Mirja Khan's jagir; in 1682 Aurangzeb converted Vijay Mandir into a mosque and renamed the town Alamgirpur
